criteria.reasoning: The lead tier row reads "1 (lead) | $2,000,000 | 1", with "lead gift = 20% × $10,000,000 = $2,000,000". It is one gift of $2,000,000.
The chart has four named tiers, $2,000,000 × 1, $1,000,000 × 2, $500,000 × 4 and $250,000 × 8, then an "All other gifts | under $250,000 | many" line. No $125,000 tier is charted.
The cumulative totals are $2,000,000, $4,000,000, $6,000,000 and $8,000,000. All other gifts is $2,000,000, which brings the cumulative total to $10,000,000. It is not reduced by booked commitments.

Hollis is "one gift in hand at the $1,000,000 tier" and Lindqvist is "one gift in hand there" at the $250,000 tier. The deliverable states "None of these donors is counted as a prospect", and neither appears in the prospects table.

The deliverable lists the Abernathy-Kim Family Fund under "Gifts in hand": "committed $500,000 at lunch... one gift in hand at the $500,000 tier, leaving 3". The $500,000 tier shows 1 gift in hand and 3 still needed. The verbal intention is treated as committed money.

Achebe-Lowry and Ashworth are excluded, but the N-coded Haraways are counted at the $250,000 tier: "The Haraways are coded N but are still rated 6, so they stay on the $250,000 line". An N-coded prospect is counted, so the criterion fails.
Rourke, Delacroix-Benn, Petrakis and Beaumont Hardware Co. are all at $250,000. The notes say "Its bottom, $400,000, is below $500,000, so all four rating-5 prospects are counted at $250,000."
The lead tier shows "3 (3:1) | 1 | 2": 3 needed, 1 identified (Castellane Foundation) and a gap of 2.
The $1,000,000 row shows 1 gift in hand, 1 still needed, "3 (3:1)" needed, 2 identified (Thornbury, Salcedo) and a gap of 1. Every figure matches.

The $500,000 row shows "1 | 3 | 12 (4:1) | 3 | 9": 1 in hand, 12 needed, 3 identified and a gap of 9. The criterion requires 0 in hand, 16 needed, 4 identified and a gap of 12. Abernathy-Kim was treated as committed.
The $250,000 row shows "28 (4:1) | 8 | 20": 8 identified and a gap of 20, because the Haraways are counted. The criterion requires 7 identified and a gap of 21.
The three biggest gaps listed are "$250,000 tier", "$500,000 tier" and "$1,000,000 tier — 1 prospect short". The $1,000,000 tier is named and the $2,000,000 lead tier is left out.

Every prospect and donor named appears in the pipeline or the commitments log, with matching ratings and codes (e.g. "Castellane Foundation (M)" rating 1, "Lucien Park (L)" rating 4). The pledge amounts ($1,000,000, $300,000, $150,000, $86,500, and the stated $500,000 intention) all come from the files. Counting Abernathy-Kim as in hand is a misapplied rule, which this criterion excludes.
